messages.content: What is the current Gini Coefficient of USA?

function.name: finance_fetchGDP
function.description: Fetch the GDP of the given country in the given year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

country.description: The name of the country to get the GDP of.

year.description: The year to get the GDP of.

message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to the latest statistics, but the most recent estimates put the United States’ Gini coefficient at roughly **0.41–0.42** (depending on the source and whether it’s measured before or after tax and transfer adjustments). For example:

| Source | Year | Gini (pre‑tax) | Gini (post‑tax & transfers) |
|--------|------|----------------|-----------------------------|
| OECD | 2022 | 0.41 | 0.39 |
| World Bank | 2021 | 0.43 | 0.40 |

If you need the absolute latest figure (e.g., for 2025), you’ll want to check the most recent releases from the U.S. Census Bureau, the OECD, or the World Bank directly.
